rows.name: OPTIONS_PAGES[26].list (bindings screen -> its binding list)
rows.method: not directly witnessed: every old use of 0x529a8 (bindings screen destroy/update at old 0x1475440-0x1475850) maps into new RVA 0x130d000-0x130dfff, a page the 26088801 capture holds encrypted (game.dll decrypts it on first use). Bracketing evidence, all unchanged: fields before the list read by readable code ([screen + 0x498f8], [screen + 0x52588], tab bar + 0x4e0, the init's +0x44608 / +0x44610), the list object's own code (old 0x1812800 -> new 0x1693a50 identical; its +0x220/+0x330/+0xae8 fields), and the Mod Bindings Menu port keeps ROW_LIST_OFFSET 338344. The mod only drives the list after its bar reads visible (alpha > 0.95) and its span/value/scroll pass the model bounds; live check C5 in NOTES.md

encrypted_page.note: readable code pages in this image measure ~5.5-6.5 bits; >7.75 is ciphertext
